content_sections.heading: PTSNS University Professor Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: A Scrutiny Committee constituted by the university will screen all valid applications using a point-based system. Shortlisting will be based on validation of the Academic/Research Score (API Score) as specified in Appendix II, Table 2 of the UGC Regulations 2018. Only candidates meeting the minimum required cumulative research score across categories (teaching, research publications, projects, patents, and policy documents) will proceed to the interview shortlist. Candidates must present verified proof of these at the time of interview. The Scrutiny Committee will independently verify the impact factor and indexing (Scopus/Web of Science/UGC-CARE) of submitted publications. Shortlist ratio for interview: For 1 vacant post, the top 20 eligible candidates based on the score matrix will be called. For every additional post, 5 additional candidates will be called. In case of a tie in scores at the cutoff mark, all tied candidates will be called for interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview; no TA/DA will be paid for attending the selection process. Only email will be sent to shortlisted candidates for interview calls.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for PTSNS University Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the online application is 30 July 2026 (till 5:30 PM), and the last date for receipt of the hard copy is 10 August 2026 (till 5:30 PM).

faq.question: Q2. How many Professor posts are vacant at PTSNS University in 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 19 Professor posts are vacant across 18 subjects, including Chemistry (2 posts) and one post each in the remaining 17 subjects.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for PTSNS University Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹2,000/- for UR/OBC/EWS candidates and ₹1,500/- for SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates, payable online.

faq.question: Q4. What is the eligibility criteria for PTSNS University Professor posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Ph.D. in the relevant discipline, a minimum of 10 years of teaching or equivalent research experience, at least 10 research publications in peer-reviewed/Scopus/Web of Science/UGC-listed journals, and evidence of academic leadership and sponsored research projects, as per UGC Regulations 2018.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay scale for PTSNS University Professor posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be placed at Academic Pay Level-14, with a pay scale of ₹1,44,200 – ₹2,18,200.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for PTSNS University Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online at ptsnsuniversity.ac.in/recruitment, then send a signed printout with self-attested documents by post to the Registrar's office in Shahdol.
